title: Topological Sort
problem: You are developing a course selection recommendation feature for an academic administration system. Given a course dependency graph (adjacency list), where each course is represented as a string, please return a valid course sequence list such that all prerequisite courses appear before each course.
strategy: Maintain an indegree table and a queue of zero indegree nodes; each time a node is popped, delete its outgoing edges.
learning_objectives: Understand how the indegree table records the remaining dependency count.
Master the strategy of using a queue to manage zero indegree nodes.
Be able to predict the state updates after popping a node at each step from a trace.
